title: CWP/782/2025 of PAWAN KUMAR Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND OTHER
text:
CWP-782-2025 1 $8 128 IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH Date of Decision:15.01.2025 PAWAN KUMAR —————eeeeee eee Petitioner Versus STATE OF HARYANA AND OTHER -_—__-__...... Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE JAGMOHAN BANSAL Present: | Mr. Virender Kumar, Advocate for the petitioner. Ms. Rajni Gupta, Addl. AG, Haryana. sek JAGMOHAN BANSAL, J. (Oral)

1. The petitioner through instant petition under Articles 226/227 of the Constitution of India is seeking direction to respondents to retain him on the pay roll as per policy dated 06.09.2019 (Annexure P-3). He is further seeking direction to respondents to decide his appeal in a time bound manner.

2. Mr. Virender Kumar, counsel for the petitioner, at the outset, submits that grievance of the petitioner, at this stage, would be redressed if respondents are directed to decide his appeal (Annexure P-6) in a time bound manner.

3. Notice of motion.

4. Ms. Rajni Gupta, Addl. AG, Haryana who on advance notice is present in Court, accepts notice on behalf of the respondent-State and waives service.

5. With consent of learned counsel for the parties, the case is ct CWP-782-2025 2 ¥8 taken up for final disposal.

6. Learned State counsel submits that Appellate Authority would consider appeal of the petitioner and pass an appropriate order within two months from today. She further assures the Court that case of the petitioner would be considered in the light of similarly situated employees.

7. Learned counsel for the petitioner agrees with aforesaid arrangement.

8. In the wake of statement of learned State counsel, the present petition stands disposed of.

9. Let the needful be done within a period of two months from today. ( JAGMOHAN BANSAL ) JUDGE 15.01.2025 Ali
